test_cases.reference_transcript: Hello, my name is John Doe and I am a software engineer with five years of experience in full stack development. I specialize in Python, JavaScript, and cloud technologies. I have worked on various projects including web applications, mobile apps, and data processing systems. I am passionate about building scalable and efficient software solutions that solve real-world problems.

The main difference between SQL and NoSQL databases is their data model. SQL databases are relational and use structured tables with predefined schemas, while NoSQL databases are non-relational and offer flexible data models. SQL is better for structured data with complex relationships, while NoSQL excels at handling unstructured data and horizontal scaling.

I have experience with multiple programming languages including Java Python C++ and JavaScript. I have worked on both frontend and backend development using React Angular Node.js and Django. I am familiar with cloud platforms like AWS Azure and Google Cloud.

My approach to problem solving involves breaking down complex issues into smaller manageable tasks. I then prioritize these tasks based on their impact and dependencies. This method helps me tackle challenges systematically and efficiently.
